about_the_game:
The Story Begins

Thirteen-year-old Willow wakes up from a strange dream in a quiet, unfamiliar hospital. Her memories are fading, her brother William is missing, and the patients she meets tell her to forget him. But Willow can’t let go—something in this place feels alive, and it remembers him too.

In this mystery point-and-click adventure, guide Willow through an arcane world full of hushed secrets and twisted hopes. Solve puzzles, explore a reality that bends and folds upon itself, and decide who Willow can trust. Some memories are worth keeping—others are best left forgotten.

Key Features

• A story-driven mystery. Unravel the hospital’s secrets through exploration and dialogue.
• Branching narrative. Shape Willow’s journey—will she be kind to those around her, or sacrifice everyone in search of her brother?
• An eerie world to explore. Solve puzzles, hide from what hunts you, and uncover fragments of forgotten memories.
